dedupe_keys.name: mfred new york apartment electricity aggregates

description: MFRED supplies real and reactive electricity power observations for 390 apartments in more than twelve New York City residential buildings. Columbia University publishes the public version as traces aggregated across fifteen apartments under the provider's stated 15/15 privacy rule. The observations cover January through December 2019 at ten-second intervals. Harvard Dataverse hosts four quarterly CSV files and a fifteen-minute aggregate table, all unrestricted under CC0 1.0 with free reuse. The resource can calibrate multifamily electricity-demand models and evaluate storage or demand-management scenarios, complementing the smaller household sample in data-uk-dale-domestic-appliance-level-electricity. A caveat is that grouped traces do not reveal individual household behaviour and should not be treated as appliance-level measurements. The selected city buildings also limit transfer to other climates and housing types. The own metadata identifies real and reactive power but the numeric tables and their column-level aggregation conventions were not inspected during this metadata-only review.
